title: Apple says the App Store has over 100K apps built for the iPhone Duo and "thousands of optimized apps are being added to the store each day" (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Apple says the App Store has over 100K apps built for the iPhone Duo and “thousands of optimized apps are being added to the store each day” — Even though a lot of apps have been updated for the iPhone Duo, they sometimes still have issues.
